notices.short_title: Request for Proposals — Information Services Franchise
notices.additional_description_1: Request for Proposals (RFP) for a nonexclusive information services franchise. The eventual franchise agreement would be subject to Franchise and Concession Review Committee (FCRC) review. Relative to OneChronos Information Services LLC.

notices.short_title: Notice of Franchise and Concession Review Committee Hearing - OneChronos LLC
notices.additional_description_1: NOTICE OF A FRANCHISE AND CONCESSION REVIEW COMMITTEE (FCRC) PUBLIC HEARING to be held on 11/10/2025, at 2:30 P.M. at 22 Reade Street, Spector Hall, New York, NY 10007 relative to the proposed information services franchise agreement between the City of New York and OneChronos Information Services LLC. The proposed franchise agreement would grant a nonexclusive franchise to construct, install, use, operate and/or maintain wire, cable, and/or optical fiber.

notices.short_title: FCRC NOVEMBER PUBLIC MEETING — OneChronos Information Services LLC
notices.additional_description_1: PUBLIC NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Franchise and Concession Review Committee will hold a public meeting on Wednesday, November 12, 2025, at 2:30 P.M. Agenda includes the proposed information services franchise agreement between the City of New York and OneChronos Information Services LLC.

notices.short_title: Award of Information Services Franchise — OneChronos Information Services LLC
notices.additional_description_1: Notice that the franchise has been awarded to OneChronos Information Services LLC following Franchise and Concession Review Committee (FCRC) approval.

notices.short_title: NOTICE OF FRANCHISE AND CONCESSION REVIEW COMMITTEE PUBLIC HEARING
notices.additional_description_1: Notice of a Franchise and Concession Review Committee (FCRC) Public Hearing on Agency Annual Concession Plans for Fiscal Year 2027 pursuant to Section 1-10 of the Concession Rules of the City of New York, to be held on Monday, June 8, 2026.
PUBLIC NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Franchise and Concession Review Committee, will hold a public meeting, on Wednesday, August 12, 2026, at 2:30 P.M., at 255 Greenwich Street, New York, NY 10007.

notices.short_title: NOTICE OF ADOPTION - AMENDMENT OF FCRC RULES
notices.additional_description_1: Notice of Adoption of amendments to the Concession Rules of the City of New York (FCRC Rules).
